access_idle: Device access session (minutes without a command)
access_idle_hint: A session opened by session.py (1 login per host, several commands) closes after N min without a command. Default 5. Applies immediately, including already open sessions.
language_help: Default language of the console (for users who have not chosen one), CLIs, scheduled tasks and generated files. Each user can choose their own in My account.
title: Project configuration
vault_ttl_hint: Idle time until it locks again (default 900)
web_networks_hint: IPv4 or IPv6, a single IP (192.0.2.7) or a network (10.0.0.0/8, 2001:db8::/32). You cannot save if your current IP is left out. The server (127.0.0.1) is always allowed.
web_proxies_hint: What sits in front of the console (e.g. Nginx, Traefik or HAProxy, with their IP). Only from these does the server accept X-Forwarded-For as the visitor's real IP; without it, everyone would look like the proxy's IP.
web_restrict: Restrict console access to the networks below (anyone outside gets 403)
your_ip: Your IP, as the server sees it:
